raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: jraph
  version: 0.0.6.dev0

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/jraph-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c3ac3a0b224b344eb6d367e8bc312d95ea41bf825d01ea31b80dd8c22c0dd8b8

build:
  number: 3
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - jax >=0.1.55
    - jaxlib >=0.1.37
    - numpy >=1.18.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - jraph
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A Graph Neural Network Library in Jax
  description: |
    Jraph (pronounced "giraffe") is a lightweight library for working with
    graph neural networks in jax. It provides a data structure for graphs,
    a set of utilities for working with graphs, and a 'zoo' of forkable
    graph neural network models.
  homepage: https://github.com/deepmind/jraph
  repository: https://github.com/deepmind/jraph
  documentation: https://jraph.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
